title: Update 10 re-test: binding, the Wisp Familiar, the Spectral Step, the Ward Lantern, the journal

steps.title: Bind a ghost
lines: Open the Containment Unit, put the Spirit Vessel (from your inventory) in the Vessel slot, pick a spirit, press Bind.
Watch the 60 s bar and listen to the tone rising; then hover the bound vessel for its tooltip.

steps.title: Wisp light in a dark tunnel
lines: Use the Bound Spirit Vessel in your hand to summon the wisp, then walk the dark tunnel.
Does the light follow you smoothly, and does it feel right? (The zombie round the corner can't move yet.)

steps.title: Wisp warning: zombie
lines: The zombie round the corner behind you is awake now. Don't turn round yet.
Is the wisp's red glow readable, and does the chirp come from the zombie's side?

steps.title: Wisp warning: creeper
lines: A frozen creeper waits round the same corner instead.
Is its chirp sharper than the zombie's?

steps.title: Wisp guide to a cabin
lines: You're 48 blocks from a real Abandoned Cabin, facing away. Sneak + use the vessel.
The wisp should fly about 8 blocks toward the cabin, wait glowing, then come back. Sneak + use again for the cooldown message.

steps.title: Recall and auto-recall
lines: Use the vessel to recall the wisp, then use it again to summon it.
Now drop the vessel (Q) or put it in a chest: the wisp should go back in.

steps.title: Unbind
lines: A ghost is already bound into the vessel in the unit's Vessel slot. Open the unit and press Unbind.
The ghost should be back in the list, and the vessel empty.

steps.title: Spectral Step
lines: Use the Spectral Step in your hand and walk north through the doors, the fence and the wall.
On another try (60 s cooldown), stop inside the fence as the phase runs out: it should last a bit longer, then nudge you out.
setup: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with paranormalcraft:spectral_step

steps.title: Ward Lantern: ring and edge preview
lines: Night on open ground. Place a Ward Lantern and watch the ring of motes trace its edge.
Then hold the other lantern: do you see the edge nearby? How does the lantern look?

steps.title: Ward Lantern: flare and spawn puffs
lines: A ghost inside a ward tries to haunt: the lantern should flare, chime and push the ghost back.
Then wait in the dark for small smoke puffs where monsters would have spawned (click Set up again to repeat the flare).

steps.title: Field Journal
lines: Page through the journal; hover every icon for its name.
Check the portrait, the Field Notes diagram and the capture log.
